issues.failure_explanation: The proof claims that the sup over the ball B_{X,\bsigma}^q(M,N) equals MN times the sup over B_{X,\bsigma}^q(1,1) with the same \bsigma. But by the definition, B_{X,\bsigma}^q(M,N) is the ball of radius M in H_{X,\bsigma} and does not depend on N, so the correct scaling factor is M, not MN. The parameter N constrains \|\bsigma^{-1}\|_{\ell_q} and enters only through a tail estimate on the Kolmogorov widths d_s = \sigma_{s+1}^{-1}. That tail estimate appears only as a garbled display with a missing left-hand side and an unjustified k^{-2/q} bound, so the bridge from Theorem thm:leastsquaresbounds to the claimed MN\,n^{-1/q} rate is absent.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the scaling identity by \sup_{B(M,N)} = M\,\sup_{B(1,1)} and complete the proof with the tail bound sqrt(n^{-1}\sum_{s\ge n}d_s^2) \le N\,n^{-1/q}, obtained from \sigma_{k}^{-1}\le N\,k^{-1/q} (a consequence of \|\bsigma^{-1}\|_{\ell_q}\le N and monotonicity) and \sum_{k\ge n}k^{-2/q}\asymp n^{1-2/q}. This is a short local correction inside the same proof.
issues.overall_effect: The convergence-rate bounds MN\,n^{-1/q}, MN\,(n/\log n)^{-1/q}, and MN\,n^{-1/q}\sqrt{\log n} in Theorem thm:varrho_n and its GPC restatement theorem:varrho_n>< are unproven as written. Downstream application theorems theorem:sampling-lognormal-affine and theorem:sampling-lognormal-holomorphic and the upper bound of equation lowerbound are likewise unproven.
issues.title: Wrong scaling identity and incomplete tail estimate in proof of Theorem thm:varrho_n
issues.why_classification: The repair corrects one displayed equation and writes out a standard tail estimate within the same proof. No new nontrivial lemma, construction, reoptimization, or replacement argument is needed, and every claim, rate, and advertised scope survives.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof of the lower bound of (lowerbound) claims d_n(B_{\CC,\bsigma}^q(M,N),L_2) \asymp MN\,n^{-1/q}(\log n)^{-\varepsilon} for the specific choice \sigma_s = s^{1/q}(\log(s+1))^{\varepsilon}. But B_{\CC,\bsigma}^q(M,N) is the ball of radius M in H_{\CC,\bsigma}, so its Kolmogorov width is M\,\sigma_{n+1}^{-1} \asymp M\,n^{-1/q}(\log n)^{-\varepsilon}, with no factor of N. For this unscaled \bsigma the constraint \|\bsigma^{-1}\|_{\ell_q} equals a fixed constant C_{\varepsilon,q} independent of N, so the displayed \asymp MN relation is false for general N.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Scale the weight sequence: take \sigma_s = A\,s^{1/q}(\log(s+1))^{\varepsilon} with A = C_{\varepsilon,q}/N so that \|\bsigma^{-1}\|_{\ell_q} = N, and recompute M\,\sigma_{n+1}^{-1} \asymp MN\,n^{-1/q}(\log n)^{-\varepsilon}. This is a short local fix within the same proof sketch.
issues.overall_effect: The lower bound MN\,n^{-1/q}(\log n)^{-\varepsilon} in equation lowerbound is unproven; the quasi-optimality claim loses its stated N-dependence unless the proof is repaired.
